## Goals for this course

- Provide a general introduction to geodynamics with a <b>focus on the lithosphere</b>
- Review <b>key geodynamic processes and the basic mathematical relationships</b> used to quantify and interpret them
- Establish some sense of the <b>current areas of focus</b> in geodynamic scientific literature
- <b>Enhance your scientific abilities</b> through practical course exercises
